notes.title: Devblog v0.02
notes.content:
Today I will tell you about cars.
Yes, there are cars in the game and it's not just about trucks. Are you tired of hauling trash in trucks and want to relax? Drive through the city streets in fast, classic cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410973/95fb19cc61bb7e319650704dbc3c41a2c9758610.png[/img]

You can buy all these cars on the in-game site specially designed for this. Are you tired of this car? Sell ​​it there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410973/1c8cdce752808d2aad26c1306f55f77250685900.png[/img]

All models are detailed, you will not notice the line between the game and reality. Stay tuned in and wait for new additions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410973/be5c961651908db95a289a51ae18d5eb767589a9.png[/img]

Also, we are waiting for you on the [url=https://discord.gg/je5nZZqHux]discord channel[/url] of the game's community, news appears there and you have the opportunity to communicate with us directly. Good luck in the garage business!

notes.title: Devblog v0.01
notes.content:
The first piece of news worth telling is that we have started to maintain a developer blog.
We thought that many would be interested to look at the process of creating a project and even participate in it, leaving feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410973/015b2ce837898f8f0329992a9df8c25ae1d879a2.png[/img]

The second piece of news is that the poor area is almost over. Buildings are sprinkled, trees and grass are planted, fences are broken, and debris is scattered. I hope you will appreciate the appearance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410973/b342380ab608c474ffb712b19a5b54b2f7b80886.png[/img]
